Interface BoardConfigLoader

All Known Implementing Classes:
JsonBoardConfigLoader
public interface BoardConfigLoader
Strategy interface for loading board configuration from an external source.

The production implementation is JsonBoardConfigLoader, which reads JSON resource files bundled in the classpath.

  • Method Details

    • getCards

      ArrayList<Set<Card>> getCards(int numPlayers)
      Returns card sets grouped by era (index 0 = era 1, 1 = era 2, 2 = era 3, index 3 = final events). Each set contains all cards valid for the given player count.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players (2–5)
      Returns:
      list of card sets, one per era plus one for final events

    • getOfferTrack

      OfferTrack getOfferTrack(int numPlayers)
      Returns the offer track populated with tiles valid for the given player count.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players (2–5)
      Returns:
      fully constructed OfferTrack

    • getOrderTile

      OrderTile getOrderTile(int numPlayers)

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players (2–5)
      Returns:
      OrderTile for that player count

    • getBuildings

      Set<Building> getBuildings()
      Returns all building cards across all eras as a flat set. Era separation and per-era selection are handled by InitGameState.makeBuildingDecks().
      Returns:
      set of all available Building cards

    • getSettings

      GameSettings getSettings(int numPlayers)
      Returns gameplay settings (row sizes, building counts per era) for the given player count.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - number of players (2–5)
      Returns:
      GameSettings for that player count
